title: Billing Rewrite: Phase 1!
body:
Rework billing so invoices are final once issued.

## Destination

Invoices never change after issue.

## Tickets

- https://github.com/acme/widgets/11 is the first decision, see https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/11 and https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/110.
- Research lives in https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/12
- https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/13, https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/14, https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/15.

## Fog

Tax handling is unclear until #12 lands.
